title: GTM Engineering Playbook 2026: Designing Autonomous Workflows Across the Funnel
summary: GTM Engineering is becoming a core function: teams that encode GTM logic into workflows and agents ship faster with less headcount. Here’s the 2026 playbook: architecture, patterns, metrics, and rollout strategy.
body_markdown:
No. RevOps often owns tooling administration and process enforcement. GTM Engineering builds reusable systems (workflows, agents, instrumentation) that change execution speed and quality across the funnel.


Start with a high-frequency, high-friction workflow: enrichment + routing, or meeting prep. You’ll unlock rep time quickly and create the foundation for better scoring.


Instrument first. If you can’t measure where the bottleneck is (latency, routing noise, missing context), you’ll automate symptoms. Build one loop, measure lift, then expand.
